Reports. Export your workforce data as CSV, Excel or PDF.
Open Reports. In New report, step one, choose a report. For example Attendance, Work hours, Productivity, Applications, Websites or Customer time.
Step two, choose the period: daily, weekly, monthly, or a custom range.
Step three, add filters: people, department or team. Leave them empty, to include everyone you are allowed to see.
Step four, pick the format. CSV is plain data. Excel is a filterable sheet, with an About tab. PDF is for sharing and printing.
Click Preview, to check the first rows on screen, before you export.
Click Generate. The report is prepared in the background, and appears under Your reports.
When it shows Ready for download, click Download.
Reports only include people and projects you are allowed to see. A screenshot report lists when screenshots were taken, but the images are never exported.
Done. Next, set up roles and dashboard access.
